name: Small Industrial Boiler - Poplar
notes:

For CH4 and N2O emission factors, they are based on Table C-2 of EPA's Final Mandatory Reporting of Greenhouse Gases Rule (see Table C-2, http://www.epa.gov/ghgreporting/documents/pdf/2009/GHG-MRR-FinalRule.pdf).

name: CO2 Credit for Carbon Sequestrated by Bio-Char
notes:
This technology accounts for the CO2 credit due to the Carbon Sequestration by Bio-char:
=-1000000/Fuel_Specs!$C$70*(T2lb*lb2g*($D$83*(Ag_Inputs!$B179*Ag_Inputs!$B$155+Ag_Inputs!$V$81*12/28*44/12)+$E$83*Ag_Inputs!$C179*Ag_Inputs!$C$155+$F$83*Ag_Inputs!$D179*Ag_Inputs!$D$155+$G$83*(Ag_Inputs!$E179*Ag_Inputs!$E$155+44/100)+Fuel_Specs!$F$70*$B$76/Fuel_Specs!$B$84))
So its unit is grams of CO2/mmbtu of Bio-char.
